neetpg2020-q001: The anatomical snuff box is bounded laterally (radial side) by the tendons of abductor pollicis longus and extensor pollicis brevis, and medially by extensor pollicis longus. Its floor is formed by the scaphoid and trapezium, and the radial artery crosses it.
neetpg2020-q002: Remnants of the mesonephric (Wolffian) duct in females are the epoophoron, paroophoron and Gartner's duct, found in the leaves of the broad ligament (mesosalpinx) and along the lateral vaginal wall.
neetpg2020-q003: The facial nerve trunk is identified using the tragal pointer, the posterior belly of digastric, the tympanomastoid suture, or by retrograde dissection from a distal branch. The inferior belly of omohyoid is not used.
neetpg2020-q004: Fertilisation occurs in the ampulla of the fallopian tube, the widest part. The fertilised egg then moves to the uterus in 3-4 days.
neetpg2020-q005: Anatomical closure of the foramen ovale occurs by about 1 year of age (functional closure is within hours after birth). Closure of the ductus venosus is by 3 weeks and ductus arteriosus by 3 weeks to 3 months. So the statement of 3 months for the foramen ovale is false.
neetpg2020-q006: Ataxia and incoordination (cerebellar signs) from thrombosis of the superior cerebellar artery occurs in the lateral pontine syndrome area. It supplies the superior surface of the cerebellum, including the dentate nucleus.
neetpg2020-q007: Foul-smelling, frothy vaginal discharge with itching and a strawberry cervix (spotted cervix) is trichomoniasis, caused by Trichomonas vaginalis. Treat with metronidazole for both partners.
neetpg2020-q008: The sternothyroid muscle is attached to the oblique line of the thyroid cartilage and prevents upward extension of a thyroid swelling. Hence the swelling can't go above the thyroid cartilage.
neetpg2020-q009: The female condom is a polyurethane sheath with a flexible ring at each end, inserted in the vagina before intercourse. The male condom is a latex sheath worn on the penis.
neetpg2020-q010: Extension of the metacarpophalangeal joints and flexion of the interphalangeal joints (claw hand) is due to paralysis of the lumbricals and interossei, which flex the MCP joints and extend the IP joints.
neetpg2020-q011: Amenorrhoea after a postpartum haemorrhage with failure of lactation is Sheehan's syndrome, caused by ischaemic necrosis of the pituitary gland during hypotension from PPH.
neetpg2020-q012: The proteasome is a large protein complex that degrades ubiquitin-tagged proteins into small peptides. This is how misfolded or short-lived proteins are removed.
neetpg2020-q013: Meiosis occurs in the germ cells of the gonads: in the adult ovary (oocytes, arrested in prophase I until ovulation) and the adult testis after puberty. In a prepubertal testis, spermatogonia remain mitotic.
neetpg2020-q014: A young girl with low-grade fever, weight loss, abdominal pain, amenorrhoea and a pelvic mass has tuberculosis with a tubo-ovarian mass. Genital TB is a common cause of infertility and amenorrhoea.
neetpg2020-q015: Tryptophan (and tyrosine) contain aromatic rings that absorb UV light at 280 nm. Replacing alanine with tryptophan would increase the absorbance.
neetpg2020-q016: The left recurrent laryngeal nerve loops under the ligamentum arteriosum, derived from the left sixth arch artery (ductus arteriosus). The right nerve loops under the right subclavian (4th arch).
neetpg2020-q017: Right facial weakness and loss of pain and temperature on the face, with loss of pain and temperature in the contralateral leg, indicates a lesion of the lateral pons (or the lateral medulla in similar cases). The key marks lateral pons.
neetpg2020-q018: The common hepatic artery gives off the gastroduodenal artery and the proper hepatic artery. Ligation affects the right gastric artery (a branch of the proper hepatic) and the right gastroepiploic artery (from the gastroduodenal).
neetpg2020-q019: Vitamin B12 is synthesised only by microorganisms and is found almost exclusively in animal products (meat, fish, eggs, dairy). Strict vegans need supplements.
neetpg2020-q020: Popeye sign is a bulge in the arm from a rupture of the long head of the biceps tendon, forming a ball of muscle. Hill-Sachs lesion is a humeral head defect in shoulder dislocation.
neetpg2020-q021: Apolipoprotein B48 arises from the same gene as B100 through RNA editing: cytidine deaminase converts a C to U in the mRNA in the intestine, creating a stop codon, so B48 is the truncated protein.
neetpg2020-q022: In obstructive jaundice the bilirubin is conjugated, so the van den Bergh reaction is direct positive. In haemolytic jaundice it is indirect positive.
neetpg2020-q023: Inguinal lymph nodes drain the lower limb, perineum, anal canal below the dentate line, vulva, penis and scrotal skin. Anal cancer (squamous, below the dentate line) spreads to them. Testicular cancer drains to para-aortic nodes.
neetpg2020-q024: Middle cerebral artery peak systolic velocity on Doppler is the non-invasive method of choice to detect fetal anaemia in Rh isoimmunisation. Amniocentesis with delta OD450 is now rarely used.
neetpg2020-q025: Granuloma inguinale (donovanosis) is caused by Klebsiella (Calymmatobacterium) granulomatis. Donovan bodies are seen in macrophages, and treatment is azithromycin.
neetpg2020-q026: Genital warts (condyloma acuminata) of the vulva are caused by the human papillomavirus, mainly types 6 and 11.
neetpg2020-q027: The uncinate process of the pancreas lies behind the superior mesenteric vein and artery. A tumour there involves the superior mesenteric vessels, which affects resectability.
neetpg2020-q028: According to Chargaff's rules, A = T and G = C. If T is 28%, then A is 28%, and A + T = 56%. The rest 44% is G + C, so cytosine is 22%.
neetpg2020-q029: The exposure from a chest X-ray is about 0.1 mGy or less, far below the 50 mGy threshold linked to fetal harm. The pregnancy should be continued and the mother reassured.
neetpg2020-q030: A low insulin to glucagon ratio (fasting) activates the gluconeogenic enzymes such as glucose-6-phosphatase, fructose-1,6-bisphosphatase, PEPCK and pyruvate carboxylase. Glucokinase, hexokinase and PFK-1 (glycolysis) are inhibited.
neetpg2020-q031: Folic acid can correct the megaloblastic anaemia of B12 deficiency by bypassing the methyl folate trap, but it does not stop neurological damage, which continues. This is why folate alone masks B12 deficiency.
neetpg2020-q032: In non-competitive inhibition the inhibitor binds at an allosteric site, so Vmax falls while Km remains unchanged. In competitive inhibition Km rises and Vmax is unchanged.
neetpg2020-q033: The otic vesicle divides into a utricular part (pars superior), giving the utricle and semicircular canals, and a saccular part (pars inferior), giving the saccule and cochlea.
neetpg2020-q034: An episiotomy extending backwards beyond the perineal body to the anal sphincter is a third-degree tear. It involves the external anal sphincter. A fourth-degree tear also involves the anal mucosa.
neetpg2020-q035: Meatoplasty widens the cartilaginous part of the external auditory canal. Tympanoplasty repairs the middle ear, myringoplasty repairs the tympanic membrane only, and otoplasty corrects prominent ears.
neetpg2020-q036: Cough on scratching the external auditory canal is due to the auricular branch of the vagus (Arnold's nerve), which supplies the canal floor, and causes a reflex cough.
neetpg2020-q037: Urine that turns black on standing, with abdominal pain, is due to homogentisate oxidase (homogentisate 1,2-dioxygenase) deficiency (alkaptonuria).
neetpg2020-q038: Tuberculous otitis media is painless (no earache), with a thin, watery discharge, multiple perforations, pale granulations and early hearing loss. Earache is not a feature.
neetpg2020-q039: Diarrhoea and a dermatitis in a sun-exposed area of the neck (Casal's necklace) in a maize eater is pellagra due to niacin deficiency (vitamin B3). Maize has bound niacin and low tryptophan.
neetpg2020-q040: Bruising behind the ear over the mastoid (Battle's sign) after head trauma indicates a basal skull fracture of the middle cranial fossa. Raccoon eyes indicates an anterior fossa fracture.
neetpg2020-q041: High-dose niacin (vitamin B3) used for dyslipidaemia can cause cystoid macular oedema (niacin maculopathy), which is reversible on stopping the drug.
neetpg2020-q042: Primary amenorrhoea with cyclical pain and a bulging membrane in the introitus in a young girl is an imperforate hymen with haematocolpos. It is treated by cruciate incision.
neetpg2020-q043: Young's operation (closure of the nostril) is done in atrophic rhinitis to reduce the airflow and crusting, allowing the mucosa to recover. It is reversible.
neetpg2020-q044: Nitric oxide is synthesised from L-arginine by nitric oxide synthase, with oxygen and NADPH, with citrulline as the by-product. It acts through guanylyl cyclase to relax vascular smooth muscle.
neetpg2020-q045: The occipitomental view with the mouth open is the Waters' view, used to examine the paranasal sinuses (maxillary sinus). Towne's view is for the occipital bone and Stenver's view for the petrous bone.
neetpg2020-q046: Ear pain, trismus (difficulty opening the mouth), dysphagia and fever with a bulging soft palate and uvula displaced to the opposite side is a peritonsillar abscess (quinsy).
neetpg2020-q047: A uterine size smaller than the gestational age, with decreased liquor volume, suggests oligohydramnios, which could be due to renal agenesis. Fetal anaemia would cause polyhydramnios or hydrops.
neetpg2020-q048: A septate uterus is treated by hysteroscopic resection of the septum (transcervical resection). The abdominal metroplasties (Jones, Tompkins, Strassmann) are no longer used.
neetpg2020-q049: The corneal endothelium pumps fluid out of the stroma with the Na+/K+ ATPase pump, keeping the cornea relatively dehydrated and transparent. Endothelial failure causes corneal oedema.
neetpg2020-q050: Satellite lesions (small separate infiltrates around the main ulcer) are characteristic of fungal keratitis, along with a dry, rough, feathery-edged ulcer with a hypopyon. A dendritic ulcer indicates herpes simplex keratitis.
neetpg2020-q051: Distichiasis is an extra row of eyelashes arising from the meibomian gland orifices, behind the grey line of the eyelid. Trichiasis is inward misdirection of normal lashes, and madarosis is loss of lashes.
neetpg2020-q052: Bilateral proptosis, restricted eye movements and chemosis in a euthyroid woman is most often thyroid eye disease (Graves ophthalmopathy), as it can occur without hyperthyroidism (euthyroid Graves). Orbital pseudotumour is usually unilateral and painful.
neetpg2020-q053: Latanoprost, a prostaglandin F2 alpha analogue, lowers intraocular pressure mainly by increasing uveoscleral outflow. Timolol reduces aqueous production, and pilocarpine increases trabecular outflow.
neetpg2020-q054: A woman with heavy but regular menstruation who has failed non-hormonal treatment (tranexamic acid, NSAIDs) is next given hormonal therapy, such as the levonorgestrel IUS, combined pills or progestins. Surgery is considered when medical treatment fails.
neetpg2020-q055: The photostress test checks macular function: the time needed for visual acuity to recover after bleaching the macula with a bright light. Recovery is prolonged in macular disease and normal in optic nerve disease.
neetpg2020-q056: A mass in the postmenopausal uterine cavity with a single feeding vessel on colour Doppler ('pedicle artery sign') is an endometrial polyp, a common cause of postmenopausal bleeding. Hysteroscopic removal and histology are needed to exclude cancer.
neetpg2020-q057: A shifting fluid sign (subretinal fluid moving with head position) is seen in exudative (serous) retinal detachment. In rhegmatogenous detachment there is a retinal break, and traction detachment shows a tight, concave surface.
neetpg2020-q058: A DCDA twin pregnancy at 38 weeks with the first twin in breech presentation and hypertension with proteinuria (pre-eclampsia) is delivered by caesarean section. A breech first twin is a contraindication to vaginal delivery.
neetpg2020-q059: Huntington disease is an autosomal dominant trinucleotide (CAG) repeat disorder in the HTT gene on chromosome 4, with anticipation. It is a gain-of-function mutation, and CUG repeats are seen in myotonic dystrophy.
neetpg2020-q060: In achalasia cardia there is loss of inhibitory neurons in the myenteric plexus of the distal oesophagus, so release of nitric oxide and VIP falls. The LES fails to relax and peristalsis is absent. LES tone is increased.
neetpg2020-q061: Oestrogen causes breast development, vaginal cornification, cervical mucus changes and endometrial proliferation (menstruation). Axillary and pubic hair growth at puberty is mediated by adrenal androgens (adrenarche), not oestrogen.
neetpg2020-q062: In paralytic squint the secondary deviation (affected eye fixing) is greater than the primary deviation, and forced duction is negative since there is no mechanical restriction. In restrictive squint, forced duction is positive.
neetpg2020-q063: Multiple warty growths on the vulva and perianal area are condyloma acuminata, caused by HPV 6 and 11. Condyloma lata (secondary syphilis) are flat and moist.
neetpg2020-q064: An eye turning inwards (esotropia) in a small child is commonly associated with hypermetropia (hyperopia), from excessive accommodative effort (accommodative esotropia).
neetpg2020-q065: Sympathetic ophthalmia is a bilateral granulomatous panuveitis that follows penetrating trauma (or intraocular surgery) to one eye. Dalen-Fuchs nodules are typical.
neetpg2020-q066: Bipolar electrocautery requires an electrolyte-containing distension medium such as normal saline. Glycine and sorbitol (non-electrolyte media) are used with monopolar cautery. CO2 is used for diagnostic hysteroscopy only.
neetpg2020-q067: Optically clear, overlapping nuclei with grooves (Orphan Annie eye nuclei) and psammoma bodies in a midline neck swelling is papillary carcinoma of the thyroid, the commonest thyroid cancer.
neetpg2020-q068: Abducens (sixth nerve) palsy, unilateral or bilateral, can be caused by cavernous sinus thrombosis, where the nerve runs freely in the sinus. It is also affected in raised intracranial pressure.
neetpg2020-q069: A patient with haematuria, oedema, severe renal failure (creatinine of 9) and a biopsy showing crescents suggests rapidly progressive glomerulonephritis. Anti-GBM antibodies should be tested for Goodpasture disease.
neetpg2020-q070: 6-Mercaptopurine is a purine analogue that inhibits purine synthesis and so DNA synthesis. Actinomycin D inhibits RNA synthesis, mitomycin cross-links DNA, and asparaginase depletes asparagine.
neetpg2020-q071: A retroperitoneal mass with lipoblasts and a branching capillary pattern and t(12;16) (FUS-DDIT3) is a myxoid liposarcoma. Well-differentiated liposarcoma has MDM2 amplification.
neetpg2020-q072: Large, friable and irregular vegetations on heart valves are seen in infective endocarditis, which destroys the valve tissue. Rheumatic vegetations are small and warty, and Libman-Sacks are small, flat and on both sides of the valve.
neetpg2020-q073: Macrocytosis (MCV 101 fL) with fatigue in a young man is seen in chronic alcoholism, due to the direct toxic effect of alcohol on the marrow and folate deficiency. Lead poisoning gives basophilic stippling with a microcytic picture.
neetpg2020-q074: Point A is 2 cm above the lateral vaginal fornix and 2 cm lateral to the cervical canal, and Point B is 3 cm lateral to point A (5 cm from the midline). So the statement that Point A is 2 cm above the external os and 5 cm lateral is false.
neetpg2020-q075: A child with a prolapsing rectal mass and painless rectal bleeding, with cystically dilated mucin-filled glands, has a juvenile polyp (hamartoma). Peutz-Jeghers polyps show arborising smooth muscle.
neetpg2020-q076: Thiazide diuretics reduce the renal clearance of lithium by increasing proximal tubular reabsorption of sodium and lithium, so lithium levels rise and toxicity (coarse tremor) results. NSAIDs and ACE inhibitors also raise lithium levels.
neetpg2020-q077: Erythromycin (and ciprofloxacin, cimetidine, fluvoxamine) inhibits the CYP1A2 metabolism of theophylline, raising its levels to toxic range (seizures, arrhythmias). Smoking lowers levels.
neetpg2020-q078: Chloroquine, hydroxychloroquine, amiodarone and chlorpromazine deposit in the cornea, causing vortex keratopathy (cornea verticillata). It is usually reversible on stopping the drug.
neetpg2020-q079: Malabsorption with diarrhoea and a duodenal biopsy showing crypt hyperplasia, villous atrophy and intraepithelial lymphocytes is coeliac disease (gluten-sensitive enteropathy), associated with HLA-DQ2 and DQ8.
neetpg2020-q080: A tattoo that has faded or disappeared from the skin may still be seen in the regional lymph nodes, where the pigment is carried by macrophages. Hence the lymph nodes draining the area are examined.
neetpg2020-q081: Antipsychotic-induced parkinsonism is treated by reducing the antipsychotic dose or giving an anticholinergic such as trihexyphenidyl (benzhexol) or benztropine. Dopaminergic drugs would worsen psychosis.
neetpg2020-q082: A woman on human menopausal gonadotropin with enlarged ovaries containing multiple cysts on ultrasound has ovarian hyperstimulation syndrome (OHSS).
neetpg2020-q083: Section 193 of the Indian Penal Code prescribes punishment for giving false evidence (perjury): up to 7 years imprisonment and a fine. Section 191 defines false evidence and 192 concerns fabricating it.
neetpg2020-q084: She is currently pregnant (1), plus a previous delivery of twins counts as one birth, so she is G2P1. Twins delivered together count as one for parity.
neetpg2020-q085: Heroin (opioids) cause marked physical dependence with a characteristic withdrawal syndrome. LSD and ketamine mainly cause psychological dependence.
neetpg2020-q086: A hysterosalpingogram showing dilated, sausage-shaped tubes with no spill of dye into the peritoneum indicates bilateral hydrosalpinx.
neetpg2020-q087: Amiodarone can cause pulmonary toxicity (interstitial pneumonitis and fibrosis), so it is contraindicated in patients with interstitial lung disease. It also causes thyroid and liver damage.
neetpg2020-q088: In a child with perianal pain after suspected sexual abuse, the Takayama test (haemin crystals) is for blood, and the Barberio test (picric acid) gives yellow needle-shaped crystals with semen. The Florence test gives dark brown crystals of choline iodide. The key marks Barberio.
neetpg2020-q089: Ranolazine inhibits the late inward sodium current in cardiac myocytes, reducing intracellular sodium and calcium overload. It is used for chronic angina. Ivabradine blocks the If current in the SA node.
neetpg2020-q090: Fever for 5 days, rash, swelling of the hands and feet with peeling of skin in a young child is Kawasaki disease, a medium-vessel vasculitis. Aspirin and IV immunoglobulin are used to prevent coronary aneurysms.
neetpg2020-q091: Macrosomia, caudal regression or cardiac defects in a baby are linked to pre-gestational diabetes mellitus in the mother, which causes congenital malformations. Gestational diabetes mainly causes macrosomia without malformations.
neetpg2020-q092: Effacement of podocyte foot processes on electron microscopy, with a normal light microscopy picture, is the hallmark of minimal change disease.
neetpg2020-q093: Radiation intensity is inversely proportional to the square of the distance from the source (inverse square law). Rapidly dividing cells such as the intestinal mucosa are the most radiosensitive.
neetpg2020-q094: Endothelial injury is the earliest and most important step in Virchow's triad that initiates thrombosis. Others are abnormal blood flow (stasis or turbulence) and hypercoagulability.
neetpg2020-q095: The instrument shown (Falope ring applicator or clip applicator) is used for tubal sterilisation (tubal ligation).
neetpg2020-q096: In rape of a young child, the hymen is often found unruptured, since it is deeply situated and the vagina cannot be penetrated fully. Injuries are found on the labia and fourchette instead.
neetpg2020-q097: Bethanechol, a muscarinic agonist, stimulates bladder contraction and is used for postoperative urinary retention. Methacholine is a bronchoconstrictor used in diagnostic tests and is avoided in COPD, while the key marks bethanechol.
neetpg2020-q098: A thyroid swelling with high TSH and antithyroid peroxidase antibodies, with lymphocytic infiltrate and Hurthle cells on histopathology, is Hashimoto thyroiditis.
neetpg2020-q099: Postcoital (emergency) contraception can be provided by high-dose oestrogen-progestin pills, copper IUCD insertion (Cu-T 200 or 380A), mifepristone (RU486) or levonorgestrel. Danazol is not a contraceptive.
neetpg2020-q100: Macrocytes, hypersegmented neutrophils and atrophic gastritis (pernicious anaemia) point to vitamin B12 deficiency from lack of intrinsic factor.
neetpg2020-q101: In a civil negligence case the onus of proof lies on the complainant (the patient), who must prove duty of care, breach of duty and damage resulting from it. In a few cases, such as res ipsa loquitur, the burden shifts.
neetpg2020-q102: Low basal TSH that rises after TRH injection suggests a hypothalamic cause (tertiary hypothyroidism), where the pituitary is able to respond. The key marks hypothyroidism due to pituitary disease; in pituitary disease TSH would not rise with TRH.
neetpg2020-q103: Tumour cells floating in pools of extracellular mucin with faint nuclei is mucinous (colloid) carcinoma of the breast, which has a good prognosis and occurs in older women.
neetpg2020-q104: Pain involving the PIP, DIP and first carpometacarpal joints with sparing of the wrist and MCP joints is osteoarthritis (Heberden and Bouchard nodes). Rheumatoid arthritis affects the MCP and wrist and spares DIP joints.
neetpg2020-q105: A young child pulled by the hand who then stops using the arm and cries when it's touched has a pulled elbow (radial head subluxation, nursemaid's elbow). It is treated by supination and flexion reduction.
neetpg2020-q106: Promethazine, a first-generation H1 antihistamine with anticholinergic action, is effective for motion sickness. Newer H1 blockers (cetirizine, loratadine) lack central action.
neetpg2020-q107: Hypoxia, confusion and petechiae 24-72 hours after a femur fracture, with SpO2 not improving on 100% oxygen (shunt), indicates fat embolism syndrome. Treatment is supportive.
neetpg2020-q108: Child-Turcotte-Pugh score: bilirubin 2-3 gives 2 points, albumin 2.8-3.5 gives 2, INR 1.7-2.3 gives 2, no encephalopathy gives 1, plus ascites points. A total of 7-9 is class B.
neetpg2020-q109: Metoclopramide (a dopamine antagonist and 5-HT4 agonist), domperidone and motilin agonists (erythromycin) are prokinetics. A diphenylmethane (such as cyclizine) is an antiemetic antihistamine and not a prokinetic.
neetpg2020-q110: For close contacts of meningococcal meningitis, chemoprophylaxis (rifampicin, ciprofloxacin or ceftriaxone) is given. Vaccines may be given as an adjunct but do not give immediate protection.
neetpg2020-q111: The triad of dementia, gait disturbance (falls) and urinary incontinence is normal pressure hydrocephalus ("wet, wobbly, wacky"). Imaging shows ventriculomegaly, and it is treated by a ventriculoperitoneal shunt.
neetpg2020-q112: In an acute exacerbation of COPD with respiratory acidosis, non-invasive positive pressure ventilation (BiPAP) is the first-line ventilatory support, which reduces intubation and mortality. Invasive ventilation is for failure of NIV.
neetpg2020-q113: Bisphosphonates (alendronate, risedronate, zoledronate) are first-line for postmenopausal osteoporosis, as they inhibit osteoclast bone resorption and reduce fracture risk.
neetpg2020-q114: A swollen belly (oedema, ascites), a 'moon face', and a rice-water diet with very low protein is kwashiorkor. Marasmus is caloric deficiency with a wasted, non-oedematous child.
neetpg2020-q115: Thrombocytopenia (with small platelets), eczema and recurrent infections is the triad of Wiskott-Aldrich syndrome, an X-linked disease caused by a WAS gene mutation.
neetpg2020-q116: Hirschsprung disease results from failure of neural crest cell migration to the distal bowel, so ganglion cells are absent in the myenteric and submucosal plexuses. The RET gene is commonly involved.
neetpg2020-q117: Koplik's spots (blue-white spots on the buccal mucosa) followed by a maculopapular rash three days later is measles.
neetpg2020-q118: Oesophageal dysmotility is common in both subtypes, but is more common in limited cutaneous systemic sclerosis. Interstitial lung disease, myopathy and renal crisis are more common in the diffuse form.
neetpg2020-q119: The first stool of a newborn is meconium, a greenish-black sticky stool, whose colour comes from biliverdin and bile pigments with swallowed amniotic debris. The key marks biliverdin.
neetpg2020-q120: A water hammer (collapsing) pulse, with a rapid rise and fall, is seen in aortic regurgitation, and in other states of wide pulse pressure like PDA, thyrotoxicosis and anaemia.
neetpg2020-q121: Beta-lactamases hydrolyse the beta-lactam ring of penicillins and cephalosporins, degrading the antibiotic. Altered penicillin-binding protein is the mechanism in MRSA.
neetpg2020-q122: Maternal IgG crosses the placenta and protects neonates against tetanus, diphtheria and measles. The key marks polio, as protection against polio from maternal antibodies is considered limited since oral vaccine is given at birth.
neetpg2020-q123: A woman on lithium who fasts for religious reasons and develops seizures may have lithium toxicity from dehydration and sodium depletion (lithium is retained). The serum lithium level should be measured.
neetpg2020-q124: Werner syndrome (adult progeria) is caused by a mutation in the WRN gene, which codes for a DNA helicase. The defect causes genomic instability and premature ageing.
neetpg2020-q125: A fully vaccinated close contact of a diphtheria case receives prophylactic erythromycin (or penicillin) for 7-10 days. A booster is given only if the last dose was over 5 years ago. The key marks erythromycin only.
neetpg2020-q126: Pegloticase is a recombinant uricase (PEGylated urate oxidase) that converts uric acid to allantoin. It is used for chronic refractory gout.
neetpg2020-q128: A low pH with low HCO3 and low pCO2 is metabolic acidosis with respiratory compensation (hyperventilation). The key marks hypoventilation causing decreased CO2 washout, which looks contradictory with the given values.
neetpg2020-q129: Rifampicin inhibits bacterial DNA-dependent RNA polymerase, inhibiting RNA synthesis. 5-Fluorouracil inhibits thymidylate synthase, and novobiocin and quinolones inhibit DNA gyrase.
neetpg2020-q130: The key marks lomefloxacin as the fluoroquinolone not given in liver disease. Pefloxacin is extensively hepatically metabolised and is also avoided. Levofloxacin and ofloxacin are renally cleared and safer.
neetpg2020-q131: Theophylline inhibits phosphodiesterases (mainly PDE3 and PDE4), and blocks adenosine A1 receptors, causing diuresis. The key marks PDE3 inhibition.
neetpg2020-q132: Pituitary apoplexy is acute haemorrhage or infarction of a pituitary adenoma, presenting with sudden severe headache, visual loss, ophthalmoplegia and hypotension or shock from acute adrenal insufficiency (ACTH loss).
neetpg2020-q133: Interleukin-4 (and IL-13) from Th2 cells induces B cells to class switch to IgE production. IL-5 promotes eosinophils and IgA production.
neetpg2020-q134: Respiratory distress, hypotension and subcutaneous emphysema after chest trauma with absent breath sounds is tension pneumothorax. Immediate needle decompression in the 5th intercostal space is life-saving, followed by chest tube insertion.
neetpg2020-q135: Polyarteritis nodosa is a necrotising vasculitis of medium-sized arteries, ANCA negative, with about 30% of cases associated with hepatitis B infection. It spares the lungs.
neetpg2020-q136: Replacement of the ciliated columnar epithelium of the airway by stratified squamous epithelium in a chronic smoker is squamous metaplasia, a reversible adaptive change.
neetpg2020-q137: A lesion of the posterior part of the superior temporal gyrus (Wernicke's area) causes fluent aphasia with impaired comprehension. Broca's area lesion causes non-fluent aphasia.
neetpg2020-q139: On a log dose-response curve, the curve furthest to the left reaches the same effect at a lower dose and so is the most potent. The key marks drug A as the most potent.
neetpg2020-q140: A 70-year-old man with diabetes and hypertension and progressive exertional dyspnoea with signs on examination points to heart failure, usually with hypertensive or ischaemic heart disease as the cause.
neetpg2020-q141: In multiple sclerosis, autoimmune destruction of the myelin sheath slows or blocks saltatory conduction along axons. Plaques form in the white matter with gliosis.
neetpg2020-q142: Morphine causes spasm of the sphincter of Oddi and increases biliary pressure, which can aggravate biliary colic. Hence NSAIDs or pethidine are preferred for biliary colic.
neetpg2020-q143: Chronic diarrhoea, failure to thrive, iron-deficiency anaemia and osteoporosis in an adolescent suggest coeliac disease. The screening test is IgA anti-tissue transglutaminase antibody.
neetpg2020-q144: Tachypnoea (Kussmaul breathing) and confusion with glucose 350, pH 7.2, HCO3 10 and a compensatory low pCO2 is diabetic ketoacidosis, a high anion gap metabolic acidosis.
neetpg2020-q145: Thiazide diuretics such as hydrochlorothiazide reduce uric acid excretion, causing hyperuricaemia and gout attacks, so they should be avoided in gout. Losartan has a uricosuric effect.
neetpg2020-q146: Dietary guidelines advise that saturated fats should provide less than 10% of total energy intake (less than 7% for people with raised cholesterol).
neetpg2020-q147: A 10-year-old boy with recurrent episodes of painful swelling of the hands (dactylitis, hand-foot syndrome) is characteristic of sickle cell anaemia. The cause is vaso-occlusion of small bones.
neetpg2020-q148: Clitoromegaly in a 46,XX child is most commonly due to congenital adrenal hyperplasia from 21-hydroxylase deficiency, which causes excess androgens. It accounts for about 90% of cases.
neetpg2020-q149: A patient with a swollen, tender leg a week after hip surgery (unilateral leg swelling, recent surgery) has a high Wells score for deep vein thrombosis. A compression ultrasound is the confirmatory test.
neetpg2020-q150: Evisceration of bowel loops through a defect to the right of an intact umbilicus, without a covering sac, is gastroschisis. In omphalocele, the sac covers the contents and the cord is attached to it.
neetpg2020-q151: Reperfused infarcted myocardium shows contraction band necrosis (hypereosinophilic bands of hypercontracted sarcomeres), due to calcium influx on restoration of blood flow.
neetpg2020-q152: All-trans retinoic acid (ATRA) is used in acute promyelocytic leukaemia, which is associated with t(15;17) giving the PML-RARA fusion gene. It induces differentiation of the promyelocytes.

neetpg2020-q170: Prolactin levels are highest in the postpartum period (about 24 hours after delivery), as the placenta gets delivered and the suckling stimulus drives release. It also rises during sleep and with stress.

neetpg2020-q188: An elderly patient with a scleroatrophic gallbladder with impacted stones and a large stone seen in the bile duct (choledocholithiasis) needs ERCP for duct clearance first, followed by cholecystectomy.
neetpg2020-q189: On duplex ultrasound at the saphenofemoral junction, the common femoral vein, artery and the great saphenous vein join to form the 'Mickey Mouse' sign. The vein forms the face and the great saphenous vein one ear.

neetpg2020-q193: The Thoracoscore predicts in-hospital mortality after thoracic surgery. It uses age, sex, ASA score, performance status, dyspnoea, priority of surgery, procedure class, diagnosis, and comorbidity. Complications of surgery are not included, as they occur afterwards.

neetpg2020-q199: On the Chicago classification, type III achalasia (spastic) has premature or spastic contractions of the distal oesophagus, with at least 20% of swallows. Type II has panoesophageal pressurisation and Type I has no pressurisation. The key marks type III.

neetpg2020-q214: The ASEPSIS wound score uses additional treatment, serous discharge, erythema, purulent exudate, separation of deep tissues, isolation of bacteria and inpatient stay. Induration is not part of the score.
neetpg2020-q215: Sharps (needles, scalpels, blades, glass) are disposed of in white translucent puncture-proof containers according to the Bio-Medical Waste Management Rules 2016.
neetpg2020-q216: Sporothrix schenckii enters the skin through traumatic inoculation (rose thorn prick), causing sporotrichosis with lymphocutaneous nodules. The other fungi listed are inhaled.
neetpg2020-q217: The Cobb angle is the standard method to measure the curve in scoliosis on an anteroposterior radiograph, between the most tilted vertebrae at the top and bottom of the curve.

neetpg2020-q219: Under the Factories Act 1948 an adult worker may not work for more than 48 hours in a week, and including overtime the total cannot exceed 60 hours in a week.

neetpg2020-q221: IgA exists in secretions as a dimer joined by a J chain and a secretory component. IgM is a pentamer and IgG is a monomer.

neetpg2020-q231: Progressive swelling of the upper limb in a woman from the north-eastern part of India suggests lymphatic filariasis. A night blood smear for microfilariae confirms it.

neetpg2020-q242: Under the ESI Act, an employee with tuberculosis is entitled to extended sickness benefit for up to 2 years (730 days) at an enhanced rate.
